The '''NA LCS 2016 Spring''' was the first professional League of Legends league season in North America for 2016, organized by Riot Games. The league ran from January 16 to April 17, 2016, with matches played in Los Angeles and the playoffs hosted at the Mandalay Bay Events Center in Las Vegas. Ten teams competed in a double round-robin Group Stage, followed by a single-elimination playoff bracket, with all Group Stage matches played as Best-of-One and all Playoff matches as Best-of-Five. The season featured the top seven teams from the [[LCS/North_America/2015/Summer|2015 Summer Split]], two teams promoted from the [[LCS/North_America/2016/Spring/Promotion|2016 Spring Promotion tournament]], and the winner of the [[Challenger Series/North_America/2015/Summer|Challenger Series 2015 Summer]]. The champion of the NA LCS 2016 Spring earned qualification to the [[Mid_Season_Invitational/2016|2016 Mid-Season Invitational]].

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''7th and 8th place''}} qualify for Summer split.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} relegate to the Promotion Tournament.
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}}
* Winner Qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2016|2016 Mid-Season Invitational]]
